        for j in range(i):

                can_work = False
                break

            current_sum += students[i][1]
            max_sum = max(max_sum, current_sum)
        else:
            # If the current student can't work, reset the current sum
            current_sum = students[i][1]
    
    # Return the maximum sum, or 0 if no valid group was found

            # If student i knows an algorithm that student j doesn't

                graph[i].append(j)
            # If student j knows an algorithm that student i doesn't
            if a[j] & ~a[i]:
                graph[j].append(i)

    # Function to find the size of the largest connected component
    def largest_connected_component():
        visited = [False] * n
        max_size = 0

        def bfs(start):
            queue = deque([start])
            visited[start] = True
            size = 0
            while queue:
                node = queue.popleft()
                size += 1
                for neighbor in graph[node]:
                    if not visited[neighbor]:
                        visited[neighbor] = True
                        queue.append(neighbor)
            return size

        for i in range(n):
            if not visited[i]:
                max_size = max(max_size, bfs(i))

        return max_size

    # Find the largest connected component
    largest_component_size = largest_connected_component()

    # If there's no group of at least two students, return 0

    component_sum = 0

    def bfs_sum(start):
        queue = deque([start])
        visited[start] = True
        nonlocal component_sum
        while queue:
            node = queue.popleft()
            component_sum += b[node]
            for neighbor in graph[node]:
                if not visited[neighbor]:

                    queue.append(neighbor)

    # Find any node in the largest component and start BFS
    for i in range(n):
